item.title: Whiskers 0.8.35
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.35

### Custom Providers

  • Added advanced request settings for custom AI providers so you can send extra headers and body fields to OpenAI-compatible endpoints
  • Added support for text, number, and on/off custom body fields so provider-specific options are easier to configure

    • ### Transcript History

  • Improved expanded transcript rows with clearer playback details, cleaner timestamps, and easier access to raw versus AI-enhanced text
  • Improved transcript selection when filtering history so select all, deselect, and export actions behave more predictably
  • Improved transcript exports with more complete timestamp formatting

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a startup issue where global hotkeys could remain unavailable briefly after launch even when Accessibility was already enabled
  • Added clearer in-app feedback when hotkeys are still initializing or need Accessibility to be re-enabled
